reason: The Land deploy failed because `./update-plugins.sh` (go run ./tools/deploy) could not build lym at 708cdadc5, the commit the deploy built (Land-deploy.log lines 2-11, trace bdfa38983e9a4ae3). That commit does not compile: internal/battencli/cancelcmd.go:288 and cleanup.go:187 call topology.DiscardTaskBranch with three arguments, but at 708cdadc5 its signature (internal/fabricengine/taskbranchdiscard.go:42) takes two; and internal/battencli/catchup.go:227 uses fabricengine.ErrRecordsLayout, which that commit lacks. The next commit on main, 540e8c9b5 ("Fabric: give five undriven failure cases a way forward", committed 14:45:26, pushed: `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` returns 540e8c9b5), changes exactly those files and makes them consistent. 708cdadc5 is an ancestor of 540e8c9b5 (merge-base --is-ancestor). Read-only check at HEAD 540e8c9b5 (clean tree): `go build ./internal/battencli ./internal/fabricengine` succeeds. So the stale build was fixed on main during the deploy window, and a re-run of Land from the prime deploys the fixed tree, with no code change needed. The Land step's record push already landed (main-weft tip on origin 412d4b548041c8435fec346a9b50329fb4eac39b, equal to the commit_created detail in the trace), so goto Land re-runs only the deploy and the remaining steps.
